description: Dialog for creating or editing a named range. Validates name syntax and the required fields, with an inline error per field (aria-invalid + role="alert") and the first invalid field taking the focus after a failed save. The dialog rides the core TmModal frame: the initial focus is the name field ("nr-name"), Escape dismisses through the frame's document-level listener and the focus returns to the grid (RestoreFocusTargetId) or to the Name Manager it was opened from, so a stacked dialog never strands the keyboard. Ctrl+Enter saves from any form field; the footer buttons are the frame's own and never double-activate. The form-field ids (#nr-name, #nr-refers, #nr-scope, #nr-sheet, #nr-comment) are a published E2E contract and one dialog is open at a time.

parameters.name: Workbook
parameters.description: The workbook containing the named range.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range to edit, or null when creating a new one.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user saves the dialog (the save button or Ctrl+Enter).

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed (Cancel, Escape or a backdrop click).

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — typically the grid root, or the Name Manager the editor was opened from. Null falls back to the opener.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto follows the viewport scope (a sheet on the narrow one); a forced value pins the mode without measuring, so a test can render the mobile sheet without a DOM.
